results.note: Full adult ticket for Carcer Tullianum with multimedia route, as listed on the official operator's (Opera Romana Pellegrinaggi) ticket shop per search result. I could not open the page directly to re-verify, so confirm before relying on it. Reduced is €5 (ages 6-17); combined Colosseum/Forum ticket is €20.
Official museum rates page: full admission €12.00 (without online booking). Includes audio guide and guided visit to the Tempio Maggiore. Online booking may add a commission.
No official page found stating a price. The statue in the piazza is a replica; the original is inside the Capitoline Museums (adult €15 per search result, not verified as the statue's own admission).
The piazza is an open public square, but only a third-party site (rome.info) says it is free. Official Turismo Roma pages list no admission fee, so I did not report free.
